card.name: Letters starting dosing abbreviations like t.i.d.
card.fires_on: A single letter that begins a dotted dosing abbreviation, such as the t in t.i.d., q in q.i.d., b in b.i.d. or p in p.m., right after a dose or 'or'. Also a digit inside a web address date.

modes.description: The first letter of t.i.d., q.i.d., b.i.d. or p.m. after a dose amount or 'or'.
